name: Circuit of the Americas
summary: America's purpose-built F1 track: a steep hill up to Turn 1 and corners modelled on other famous tracks.
character: A steep climb to the Turn 1 hairpin, then a run of fast esses modelled on Silverstone's Maggotts and Becketts. The track is famously bumpy. Wide corners let drivers try different lines.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.note: Steep uphill hairpin with a blind apex, wide enough that half the field tries to fit into it at once.

corners.name: Turns 3-6
corners.note: Fast esses based on Silverstone's Maggotts and Becketts.

moments.title: Hamilton's third title
moments.body: Lewis Hamilton won in Austin in 2015 to wrap up his third championship with three races to spare.

history.body: First race, bringing F1 back to the United States after five years away.
Joined by Miami and Las Vegas: three US races in one season.
